item.title: My New Daily
item.description:
My New F10 535i M Sport: From Skepticism to Daily Driver

I originally went out looking for a 2004 Acura TL with a manual transmission, but my plans took an turn when I came across this 2012 BMW 535i M Sport RWD. I jumped on it immediately, the seller mentioned it needed a water pump, which is pretty typical BMW stuff.

At first, I was skeptical. The car had a number of voltage-related faults, more than the seller let on. But I made an offer anyway… and shockingly, he accepted. So now I’m the proud owner of this beautiful F10!

item.title: Valvetronic Motor Replacement
item.description:
Valvetronic Motor Replacement on the F10 535i

Paradise didn’t last too long. I started noticing the idle was a bit lumpy, and the low-end torque was practically non-existent. Then came the dreaded Valvetronic motor clicking when unlocking the car. I knew I was in for a long day.

I ordered a new Valvetronic servomotor, a valve cover gasket, and a cheap injector puller tool off Amazon to tackle the job. Unfortunately, BMW engineers decided to bury this servomotor ridiculously deep in the engine.
